confidence_notes: Food anchors use current Gold Coast price-index readings; the July pricing window and contributor data add uncertainty. The cocktail estimate uses a local menu-price median, while the wine glass is estimated from its local price relationship to beer. Accommodation estimates are holistic, based on the supplied Australian comparables and Gold Coast's tourism demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Gold Coast's resort demand supports three-star prices around Sydney and Perth levels. Basic rooms fall between Wollongong and those cities; hostel prices are close to the supplied Sydney and Perth comparables.
